title: Public agent systems and reusable agent capability source
description: A resumable GitHub discovery campaign for complete agent stacks and the hooks, skills, playbooks, tools, memory, orchestration, evaluation, and protocol components that can improve them.
rights_policy: Metadata and public locators may be observed. Source reuse requires direct license and provenance review; discovery never grants promotion or redistribution rights.
stop_conditions: GitHub search quota has fewer than two requests remaining.
GitHub returns a rate-limit, abuse-detection, authentication, or access error.
A response cannot be parsed or safely checkpointed.
The configured query or output scope expands beyond public repository metadata.
